title: Change request
description: Opened by telemetry, not by a person. A SigNoz alert on conformance or unmapped fields writes one of these; the agent picks it up and proposes; a human approves or rejects. `rejected` is a first-class outcome — the interlock exists so that a plausible-looking repair can be turned down and escalated rather than shipped.

opened_by.title: Opened by
opened_by.description: Nobody files these by hand. That is the claim.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: The raw numbers that opened it, so a human can disagree with the agent's reading of them.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Filled in only by a re-run. Absent = not releasable.
